output_text:
```python
import os
from typing import Dict, List, Any, Optional
from dataclasses import dataclass

@dataclass
class ReceiptItem:
    description: str
    quantity: Optional[float]
    unit_price: Optional[float]
    total_price: Optional[float]

@dataclass
class ReceiptData:
    merchant: Optional[str]
    tax: Optional[float]
    total: Optional[float]
    items: List[ReceiptItem]

def extract_receipt_data(image_path: str) -> ReceiptData:
    from azure.ai.documentintelligence import DocumentIntelligenceClient
    from azure.ai.documentintelligence.models import AnalyzeDocumentRequest
    from azure.core.credentials import AzureKeyCredential
    
    endpoint = os.getenv("AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_ENDPOINT")
    key = os.getenv("AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_KEY")
    
    if not endpoint or not key:
        raise ValueError("Azure Document Intelligence credentials not set")
    
    client = DocumentIntelligenceClient(endpoint=endpoint, credential=AzureKeyCredential(key))
    
    with open(image_path, "rb") as f:
        poller = client.begin_analyze_document(
            "prebuilt-invoice",
            AnalyzeDocumentRequest(bytes_source=f.read())
        )
    
    result = poller.result()
    
    merchant = None
    tax = None
    total = None
    items = []
    
    if result.documents:
        doc = result.documents[0]
        fields = doc.fields
        
        merchant_field = fields.get("VendorName")
        if merchant_field and merchant_field.value:
            merchant = merchant_field.value
        
        tax_field = fields.get("TotalTax")
        if tax_field and tax_field.value:
            tax = float(tax_field.value)
        
        total_field = fields.get("InvoiceTotal")
        if total_field and total_field.value:
            total = float(total_field.value)
        
        items_field = fields.get("Items")
        if items_field and items_field.value:
            for item in items_field.value:
                item_dict = item.value
                description = None
                quantity = None
                unit_price = None
                total_price = None
                
                desc_field = item_dict.get("Description")
                if desc_field and desc_field.value:
                    description = desc_field.value
                
                qty_field = item_dict.get("Quantity")
                if qty_field and qty_field.value:
                    quantity = float(qty_field.value)
                
                unit_price_field = item_dict.get("UnitPrice")
                if unit_price_field and unit_price_field.value:
                    unit_price = float(unit_price_field.value)
                
                amount_field = item_dict.get("Amount")
                if amount_field and amount_field.value:
                    total_price = float(amount_field.value)
                
                if description:
                    items.append(ReceiptItem(
                        description=description,
                        quantity=quantity,
                        unit_price=unit_price,
                        total_price=total_price
                    ))
    
    return ReceiptData(
        merchant=merchant,
        tax=tax,
        total=total,
        items=items
    )
```
